name: openbb_news_search
description:
Recent world and market news through the OpenBB Platform (obb.news.world); despite the name, this command has no keyword parameter, so the query does not filter the articles.
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): query*; limit (number of articles; sent only when given; schema default 20); provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts benzinga, fmp, intrinio or tiingo (all need a key); schema default benzinga, but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it).
Company news: openbb_company_news (provider yfinance needs no key), yf_news; keyword news search: tavily_news_search. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"query": "central bank", "limit": 10, "provider": "fmp"}
